note: First real roleplay captured during M0 Spike 1. Kept verbatim, including two turn-detection artifacts (consecutive same-speaker turns at indices 9-10 and 11-12) where VAD split or merged a turn. Those artifacts are the point: scoring must not mis-attribute across them, and D13's attribution check is what catches it. The rep performs badly here on purpose-of-record - vague, no value proposition, and he reverses roles by asking the buyer for advice - which makes this a useful low-score fixture for the eval harness.
